section.heading: Admissions not conclusive proof, but may estop
section.html: Admissions are not conclusive proof of the matters admitted but they may operate as estoppels under the provisions hereinafter contained. STATEMENTS BY PERSONS WHO CANNOT BE CALLED AS WITNESSES
